enrichment.freeze_tx: hash of the earliest AddedBlackList / Blacklisted / AddressFrozen / FreezeAddress event emitted by the source contract that names this wallet. Tron txs are hex (as TronGrid returns).
enrichment.frozen_at: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the freeze block. Omitted (null) if the on-chain record did not supply a timestamp; such rows are also listed in `unresolved` with a reason.

method: Full-history paginated event scan per source contract (Etherscan V2 logs/getLogs for ETH, TronGrid v1/contracts/{addr}/events for Tron); wallet-indexed; earliest timestamp kept.
